name: Electronic Address
definition: Address which is accessed by electronic means.

URLAddress.name: URL Address
URLAddress.definition: Address for the Universal Resource Locator (URL), eg, used over the www (HTTP) service.

ISDNAddress.name: ISDN Address
ISDNAddress.definition: Address for an Integrated Services Digital Network.

RelatedPresentation.name: Related Presentation
RelatedPresentation.definition: Presentation process for which an electronic presentation address is specified.
